messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem thread — we promised concrete remediation for rollout safety. I want a minimal, testable spec we can ship this sprint: cohort-aware auto-rollback, staged ramps, and per-flag blast-radius limits. Owners + ETAs by EOD tomorrow?

mona: Sounds good. Can we define exact signals and thresholds so the rollout controller can be unit-tested?

raj: Suggestion: pair an infrastructure health metric (5xx) with a customer-impact metric (checkout failure). Latency spikes are too noisy on their own. Also ensure we evaluate at cohort/region granularity to avoid global rollbacks.

alex: Draft proposal: ramp = [1%, 10%, 50%], min_stage = 30m. Auto-rollback if both conditions met within same cohort: http_5xx_rate > 2.5% over 5m AND checkout_failure_rate > 0.5% over 5m. Also add a per-flag blast_radius_cap applied for the first 72h.

sam: Also: cap absolute exposure for platform-critical flags (payments, auth). Example: blast_radius_cap = 20% by policy. If a team needs higher, they must request SRE signoff and a validated canary.

mona: Example rollout-controller config for discussion:

```
flag: payments_v2
ramp_percent: [1,10,50]
min_stage_duration: 30m
auto_rollback:
  require_all: true
  conditions:
    - metric: http_5xx_rate
      threshold_pct: 2.5
      window: 5m
    - metric: checkout_failure_rate
      threshold_pct: 0.5
      window: 5m
blast_radius_cap_pct: 20
cohort_evaluation: true
```

raj: That config is clear. Two implementation notes: (1) cohort_evaluation must use the same cohort key as analytics (user_bucket, region), not service-only shards; (2) synthetic canary tests should run before stage transition and their failures count toward rollback.

alex: Action items captured: 1) mona implement rollout-controller changes + unit/integration tests (owner: mona, ETA: 2025-07-01). 2) raj implement cohort aggregation + synthetic canary harness + dashboards (owner: raj, ETA: 2025-06-27). 3) sam draft blast-radius policy with exceptions + approval flow (owner: sam, ETA: 2025-06-29). I will run a 48h validation window after the first production rollout and own the post-rollout review.

ops-bot: NOTE: INC-2025-043 follow-ups assigned [mona, raj, sam]. Postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2025-043

sam: Acknowledged. I'll include rollout examples, escalation playbook, and sample dashboard panels for the monitor runbooks.

mona: I'll open a draft PR with config schema + tests and tag the canary infra team for review.

alex: Thanks — let's meet Fri 9am to review the PR and finalize safe defaults. Short thread, but good alignment.
